title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating human-AI co-design requires testing whether coding agents can translate real users' multimodal requests into working application revisions. We introduce Co-Design Bench, a reference-free benchmark of 273 tasks curated from 37,463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 real user coding sessions. Its two tracks, Multimodal Editing (ME) and Repository Editing (RE), cover localized edits with optional image, audio, video, or document inputs and coordinated repository revisions. Tasks span three capability dimensions: Grounded Understanding, UI Transformation, and Functional Implementation. The tasks pair normalized requests and runnable pre-edit applications with 2,331 hidden expert-authored acceptance criteria. Our judge-then-refute protocol grades criteria using source and browser evidence, challenges positive verdicts with a separate LLM verifier, and audits visual and interaction claims without gold code or target screenshots. translated_title: Co-Design Bench：面向智能体模型的多模态协作编程评估基准
translated_abstract: 评估人机协同设计需要测试编程智能体能否将真实用户的多模态请求转化为可运行的应用修订。我们提出了Co-Design Bench，这是一个无参考基准，包含从26,314个真实用户编程会话中37,463条去重查询精选出的273个任务。该基准设有两个赛道：多模态编辑（ME）和仓库编辑（RE），涵盖带有可选图像、音频、视频或文档输入的局部编辑以及协调的仓库级修订。任务涵盖三个能力维度：扎根理解、UI转换和功能实现。每个任务将规范化请求和可运行的编辑前应用与2,331条隐藏的专家编写验收标准相配对。我们的“先评判后反驳”协议使用源代码和浏览器证据对验收标准进行评分，通过独立的LLM验证器对正面判定进行质疑，并在没有黄金代码或目标截图的情况下审计视觉与交互方面的声明。
tldr: Co-Design Bench是一个从真实用户编程会话中构建的无参考基准，用于评估智能体模型能否将用户的多模态请求转化为可运行的应用修订，涵盖多模态编辑与仓库编辑两大赛道及扎根理解、UI转换、功能实现三项能力维度。
en_tdlr: Co-Design Bench is a reference-free benchmark built from real user coding sessions that evaluates whether agentic models can translate users' multimodal requests into working application revisions, spanning Multimodal Editing and Repository Editing tracks across three capability dimensions.
